observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Underexposure collapses major arena surfaces into black shapes
observations.context: All four Inkfall Rev5 player-eye views
observations.action: Traverse forward from the west spawn and rotate through the Press Hall, Ink Channel, and archive views
observations.expectation: Routes, cover, vertical connections, and material boundaries remain readable while retaining a dark industrial mood
observations.actual: Large floor, wall, ceiling, and weapon regions lose surface information; silhouettes merge and depth cues depend heavily on cyan strips
observations.playerConsequence: Navigation, enemy spotting, cover reading, and confidence in collision truth are weakened
reproduction: Inspect the center and lower half at normal viewing size
hypotheses: Ambient and fill contribution is too low for the current dark albedo palette
Material roughness and value separation are insufficient at gameplay distance
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Capture the same route with a bounded lighting/material-value revision and compare cropped route silhouettes
observations.recommendedOutcome: Retain the nocturnal foundry tone while making navigable planes, cover, and vertical links legible without relying on emissive strips

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Portal presentation does not yet read as one intentional traversable machine
observations.action: Look toward the orange rings and red fold from ordinary combat distance
observations.expectation: A unique framed gateway, active field, entry plane, and destination behavior read immediately
observations.actual: The visible orange forms read as disconnected floating rings with black centers, while the red rectangle competes as a separate portal-like object
observations.playerConsequence: Players cannot confidently predict which object is usable, where to enter, or what visual language identifies linked travel
reproduction: Compare the orange ring group with the red rectangular fold
hypotheses: The imported frame is not presented close enough to its energy field in the runtime composition
The field lacks a luminous surface, depth distortion, or directional destination cue
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Capture a close frontal approach, activation, traversal, and exit sequence for both linked endpoints
observations.recommendedOutcome: Unify frame, pad, field, and destination cue into one unmistakable portal with a single visual grammar

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Repeated thin supports and rails make the hall look scaffolded and machine-assembled
observations.context: Press Hall ramp and Ink Channel side view
observations.action: View the ramp and bridge supports from below and beside the traversal route
observations.expectation: Structural elements communicate believable load paths and reinforce route hierarchy
observations.actual: Closely repeated posts, dangling feet, diagonal braces, rails, and ceiling bars compete at similar visual weight and sometimes appear detached
observations.playerConsequence: The map reads as an unfinished construction kit and produces unnecessary target-lane noise
reproduction: Follow the ramp support rhythm from foreground to background
hypotheses: Donor truss repetition was optimized for coverage rather than authored structural grouping
Secondary detail has not been culled by combat-distance importance
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Author one cleaned structural bay with fewer thicker load-bearing members and compare route readability
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use fewer, stronger structural groups with credible connections and deliberate negative space

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Blocky rifle and flat HUD remain the strongest unfinished signals
observations.action: Read the combat view at normal size
observations.expectation: Weapon, HUD, and arena share a polished restrained industrial-sci-fi language while preserving a clear center
observations.actual: The rifle is a large near-black angular placeholder with little material or mechanical definition; the HUD uses thin boxed strips and mismatched typography that sit apart from the world
observations.playerConsequence: The two surfaces seen continuously make the entire build feel earlier and more synthetic than the map implementation actually is
reproduction: Compare the lower-right weapon and bottom HUD with the arena geometry
hypotheses: The accepted gun-pack presentation has not replaced the current first-person runtime mesh
HUD layers are still transitional implementations from different revision lanes
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Bind one accepted rifle and one unified match HUD view model, then recapture the identical route
observations.recommendedOutcome: Replace the placeholder first-person rifle and converge the HUD into one restrained, authored, high-legibility system

observations.label: UNKNOWN
observations.title: Current packet cannot establish portal traversal quality
observations.action: Attempt to judge approach, activation, traversal, exit, and reconnect behavior
observations.expectation: Evidence shows the complete notice-to-entry-to-exit loop from player eye
observations.actual: The packet contains distant static views and movement-state proof but no close frontal portal sequence, transition frames, audio, or exit confirmation
observations.playerConsequence: Portal usability, motion quality, destination comprehension, and comfort remain unreviewed
reproduction: Look for a complete portal entry and exit sequence
hypotheses: The visual continuity script was designed for route coverage rather than portal acceptance
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Add a bounded portal-focused video or frame sequence including approach, preview, entry, exit, and reconnect
observations.recommendedOutcome: Provide a player-eye portal packet that proves clear affordance, smooth travel, destination readability, and authority continuity
